According to the Hermes Agent documentation, **in-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed**. 

Instead of opening a PR directly into the main repository, you should build YantrikDB as an **external memory provider**:

1. Implement the `MemoryProvider` interface.
2. Place the plugin in `~/.hermes/plugins/`.
3. Enable it using `hermes plugins enable <name>`.
